displayName: Catalog: a daily check needs a look

documentation.content: The daily cost check (Cloud Run job catalog-cost-reconcile, 06:00 UTC) wrote an alert in the last 24 hours. Open the Ops page (/catalog/ops): the Reliability card lists it under incidents (kind "daily check") with its cause, and the Cost card shows the day. The alerts: the cost ledger holds more for a service than Cloud Run billed (the ledger over-counts; check the per-call prices in catalog/cost.ts against the service shape), a catalog service or job without the app, component and env labels (redeploy it through infra/deploy.sh or its infra script, which add them), a service shape with no list price in the rate card (packages/core/src/catalog/cost-reconcile.ts CPU_MEMORY_RATES and GPU_RATES), or the 7-day batch success rate under 99%. Each alert is written once per day and component; the alert closes by itself after 24 hours.
